ownerVocabulary.AGENT: Agent does it end to end, no human needed.

ownerVocabulary.EXTERNAL: Waits on Discord / a third party. Agent tracks it and keeps the fallback ready.

items.title: Worker throughput
items.detail: Today one cron (every minute) runs worker.tick() with POSTRIFF_WORKER_MAX_JOBS default 10 (hard cap 25) and POSTRIFF_WORKER_MAX_SECONDS default 20 (cap 45), sequentially. With the Discord worker flag, lanes alternate between Discord and the rest, and a post needs at least two steps (create, then read-back). Rough ceiling: about 5 posts per minute at defaults, about 12 at the cap. 100 posts due in the same minute take 8 to 20 minutes; 1,000 take 83 to 200 minutes. tick_discord exists but is not wired to any cron. Decide: (a) the Wave 1 cap makes this acceptable; (b) raise POSTRIFF_WORKER_MAX_JOBS to 25 and MAX_SECONDS toward 45 (affects all providers; the API function maxDuration is 300); (c) add parallel cron lanes or a dedicated Discord lane (Wave 2, needs SKIP LOCKED and lease-fence proofs). Measure instead of assuming; show late-post expectation in the UI.
items.evidenceRequired: Measured jobs per minute in CI; decision recorded; UI expectation copy.
items.basis: hosted_worker.py configured_worker_limits and _tick; vercel.json crons [Certain]; steps per post [Likely].
items.note: decision recorded with the budget arithmetic; per-step latency not measured; late-post note in the schedule dialog

items.detail: Two synthetic workspaces; cross-tenant read and write of Discord resources must be denied. Use the existing harness. If it needs accounts the agent cannot create, mark BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and add to the Approval Packet.
items.basis: PR #216 lists hosted application tenant isolation as unqualified.

items.title: Rollback target
items.detail: Name a compatible READY production deployment by fingerprint, not by guess (candidates seen on 10-22: dpl_349BPQoCn1p857TxmQaaKhDb2Lrx, dpl_AkP8r1Lfx4nWgCYSJuJxCKWkF3yM, and dpl_yKAToJbv... whose full id must be looked up; none verified for compatibility). Rule: before any rollback to an older worker, set the kill switch and drain or reconcile in-flight Discord jobs (lease-protocol fence, migration 128).

items.title: Dark promotion (gate closed except testers and grandfathered workspaces)
items.detail: After AUTH-5: promote the verified RC; confirm https://rafii.io/api/health, that public workspaces see the waitlist state, and one cron 200 per minute.

items.title: Real OAuth and bot install (PRD A08)
items.detail: Tester account installs the bot into the tester server through the supported flow on rafii.io. Agent verifies with own-workspace readbacks (no secrets): one code exchange, channel record, capability rows, destination list limited to channels the tester can see.
items.basis: Earlier callback duplicated one-use code exchanges; watch for double POSTs.
items.note: waits for the dark promotion and the tester session

items.title: One real send and read-back (PRD A09)
items.detail: Owner approves the exact text, sender, channel and time in the product UI. Verify the message exists, matches, mentions are suppressed and the read-back receipt is verified. Maximum 3 messages in total.
items.note: waits for the dark promotion and the tester session

items.title: Unattended schedule and cancel (PRD A10)
items.detail: Schedule a post at least 5 minutes ahead and do nothing; the production cron must send it and the read-back must verify. Record the delay. Schedule a second post and cancel before due; nothing may be sent.
items.note: waits for the dark promotion and the tester session

items.title: Revoke and reconnect
items.detail: Remove the bot from the tester server. The next attempt must be held with a clear reconnect message and no retry storm; the connection must show reauthorization needed; reconnect must work.
items.note: waits for the dark promotion and the tester session

items.title: Permission failure
items.detail: Channel the bot cannot post in: the job must be held with a clear reason and no message.
items.note: waits for the dark promotion and the tester session

items.title: Release receipt (PRD A13)
items.detail: Project, SHA, deployment ID, ready state, acceptance results, cost if observed, rollback target. No secrets, no customer data.
items.basis: CLAUDE.md end-of-release record.
items.note: waits for the dark promotion and the tester session

items.title: Cap race under load (synthetic)
items.detail: CI test with simultaneous connect starts around the cap; in production only verify the count query.
items.note: test written and passing locally on PostgreSQL 16 (12 racers, 5 slots, 2 held; exactly 3 admitted, count never above the cap; a no-lock control overshoots). Production check is the Q9 count query only. CI evidence = the qualification workflow (PostgreSQL 17) on the frozen head

items.title: Post-acceptance exposure decision
items.detail: Only after X-03 and X-04 are VERIFIED: recommend opening the capped public gate (Approval Packet #2 / AUTH-6). If either failed: NO-GO, fallback F-02.

items.title: Privacy notice and terms
items.detail: Compare the Discord text in the privacy notice and terms with real behaviour: server and channel ids, bot permissions, revocation, retention, no message text stored, deletion on account removal. Draft edits for H-08.

items.title: Discord Developer Policy and Terms review
items.detail: Read the current public Discord Developer Policy / Terms and produce a compliance table against Rafii behaviour (no mass mentions, no unsolicited DMs, data use, disclosure, deletion). List gaps for the owner.

items.title: Account deletion and shared-server behaviour
items.detail: Verify deleting a workspace removes its Discord grants and tokens, and that the shared bot stays while another workspace still uses the same server.
items.basis: account_deletion.py comment on shared bot.
items.note: workspace deletion cascades the Discord credential rows; the shared bot is never removed from a server, by design on this line; disclosed in the draft wording

items.title: Monitoring queries and thresholds (aggregate-only)
items.detail: Per-5-minute counts from pr_discord_request_admissions (status_code, state, is_publish), held and uncertain job counts, rate-state blocked_until / circuit_until, OAuth failures, Vercel runtime errors. Page on: invalid-request rate above 1,000 per 10 minutes, any circuit open more than 5 minutes, 3 or more uncertain sends in 15 minutes, 5xx above 2 percent for 5 minutes, policy expiry within 7 days.
items.note: eleven aggregate-only monitors with thresholds; every statement planned against the production schema with EXPLAIN (no rows read)

items.title: Abort triggers and pre-authorised actions
items.detail: Write the exact triggers and the action for each (kill switch first, then close gate, then rollback only for code defects). Ready as AUTH-7.

items.title: Runbooks
items.detail: Launch-day runbook (T-minus), incident runbook (Discord outage, 1015 ban, policy expiry, bot-token compromise with the owner-only rotation steps and the all-customers impact), customer comms templates.

items.title: Renewal and rotation calendar
items.detail: Rate-policy expiry, bot-token and client-secret rotation reminders.

items.detail: Aggregate-only reports at T+2h and T+24h: connects, caps, errors, delays, held and uncertain jobs.

items.title: GO / NO-GO evaluation
items.detail: At GO_TIME generate the table of every MUST item with status and evidence link and give a recommendation. Declare NO-GO early when a MUST gate can no longer pass, not at the deadline.
items.note: evaluated at GO_TIME; today the recommendation is NO-GO

items.title: Fallback (NO-GO)
items.detail: Gate stays closed (tester and grandfathered workspaces only), the public sees the waitlist state, no data is lost and existing grants stay safe. Config diff and customer message prepared in advance. Reschedule criteria stated.
items.note: the fallback is that D1 (gate closed) stays promoted; the customer wording exists; reschedule criteria not written

items.title: Abort / rollback decision tree after opening
items.detail: Kill switch (seconds, reversible) then close gate then rollback to the verified target only for a code defect, after draining in-flight Discord jobs.

items.detail: Per CLAUDE.md: project, SHA, deployment ID, ready state, acceptance results, cost if observed, rollback target; privacy-preserving.
